title: Checkout collects shipping details
description: A signed-in shopper with items in the cart enters first name, last name and postal code before reviewing the order.

acceptanceCriteria.text: When the postal code is missing and the shopper continues, the error "Error: Postal Code is required" is shown.
With the Sauce Labs Backpack and Sauce Labs Onesie in the cart and all details entered, the overview shows "Total: $41.02".
After finishing the order the shopper sees "Thank you for your order!".

source: examples/requirements (synthetic example for the saucedemo.com demo target)
